title: Identify the end points
text: We saw that the domain is $$[0,2]$$ and the range is $$[-\pi/2,\pi/2].$$ We know that when $$x=0, $$ $$\theta=-\pi/2;$$ when $$x=2, $$ $$\theta=\pi/2.$$
